nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle 2-in-1 Exfoliating & Glow Toner Pads

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing it as maturing or drying further in summer heat, consistently say the pads hydrate rather than dry out their skin, unlike some toners they have tried before.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with an oily T-zone, report no issues using the pads and some note fewer breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with sensitive, dry, combination skin, say the pads feel gentle and calming with no irritation, even when their skin is already feeling sensitive.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report smoother texture, hydration and a dewy glow, though one says she did not notice an improvement in elasticity specifically, which she attributes to her age.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with dry or dry-maturing skin, say the pads leave their face noticeably more hydrated, plump and dewy, with one saying they relieved dryness from a harsh summer; one dissenting reviewer says her skin still felt pretty dry despite regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including one managing postpartum skin and another with a combination skin type, report fewer breakouts or no new blemishes with regular use, though one reviewer experienced breakouts alongside ongoing dryness and said she would not repurchase.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer who specifically targeted redness, on her cheeks, says the calming pads did not noticeably reduce it, though the collagen gel pads still left her skin looking radiant.
concerns.barrier: The reviewers who mention their skin barrier say the formula supports and strengthens it alongside long-lasting moisture, with no reports of barrier disruption.
concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging skin report smoother texture and a plumped, dewy look, though one says she did not see a specific improvement in elasticity.

aspects.libelle: Tweezers keep pads sanitary to handle
Tweezer trays fiddly, hard to grab one pad
Uneven pad counts, exfoliating pads run out first
Generous pad count for the price

extraits.texte: This is a fun set, I like how there are two different steps. I didn't love the results however. My skin still felt pretty dry and I experienced some breakouts so I don't think it's a great fit for me personally. It also was a little involved to have to leave it on for a few minutes each night and I had trouble just getting one pad at a time to come out (the tweezers didn't really help) so I wouldn't buy these again.

The d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad is a luxurious duo that both tones and hydrates the skin. I received a free sample for the purpose of an honest review. This wonderfully packaged product is best used in the morning, because it preps the skin for makeup application. I have dry skin, and sometimes toners really dry my skin out even more. This one did not do so! It is a simple system that is packaged so well. You take the toner pad and go over your skin; you may also leave the pads on for a few minutes, if you choose to. . Then you move on to the Vita Toning Collagen Gel Pad. Simply place the pads onto the face on areas that need hydration. Leave them on a few minutes, remove, and massage the serum into your skin. The ingredients are excellent . Skin is refreshed, toned, with superior hydration. Your skin will have a beautiful glassy appearance, and it is prepped for your foundation! Makeup goes on smoothly and does not 'pill' at all. It is a superior system, easy to use, packaged well, and it delivers excellent results. I love it!

extraits.titre: Glow game changer, so worth it
extraits.texte: Thank you so much for sending me this product to try in exchange for an honest review. I will admit that I was skeptical at first but my mind changed after the first use. I have red cheeks and applied the calming pads to those areas. It didn't do much to calm the redness. I applied the collagen gel pads on my cheeks and forehead, leaving them to penetrate for about 10 minutes. They left my skin looking so radiant and my skin had a glow! I personally prefer the calming pads. I really appreciate that tweezers are included to help separate and grab the right amount of product. It also helps keep the contents of the product hygienic.

This was essentially a 2-step prep system designed to help your makeup go on smoother and help prevent a "cakey" finish. This worked well for my aging skin. Although I no longer use a lot of face makeup, this duo leaves my skin smooth and slightly dewey. I would say this help exfoliate and hydrate my skin, but I didn't necessarily see an improvement in its elasticity (but that could be due to my age).

The d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pads have become one of my favorite skincare steps when my skin needs a quick refresh. I have sensitive dry combination skin. The pads are generously soaked with serum and feel soft and comfortable on my skin. They instantly leave my face feeling hydrated, calm, and refreshed without any sticky residue. I like using them as a quick mask for a few minutes before moisturizing, and my skin always looks smoother and more radiant. The formula feels gentle, making it suitable even when my skin is feeling a little dry or sensitive. Overall, these serum mask pads are a convenient way to add an extra boost of hydration and give my complexion a healthy, dewy glow.

extraits.titre: Made my skin feel soft and smooth
extraits.texte: These pads really renewed my skin and left it feeling soft and smooth. I have dry, mature skin with light texture. I used this product twice a day for 2 weeks and it really softened the texture and left my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. The packaging was convenient and durable and each pad was saturated with product. I loved the little plastic tongs provided to help grip the pads. The serums didn't have an overwhelming fragrance and didn't leave my skin sticky or tacky. Overall I'm very happy with this product and just purchased a replacement. Thank you for the sampling opportunity.

If you're dealing with postpartum skin that's looking tired, textured, or congested, these pads have been such a game changer for me. I love that you get two types of pads in one container—one focuses on gentle exfoliation while the other delivers a boost of hydration. Using them a few times a week helped smooth my skin, reduce the look of the little postpartum bumps I was getting, and left my face looking brighter without irritation. My skin always feels incredibly soft and refreshed afterward, and they prep my skin so well for the rest of my routine. They've become one of those products I reach for whenever my skin needs a quick reset. These are honest skincare experiences, and while no product can guarantee clearing acne, keeping your skin hydrated and gently exfoliated can absolutely help improve the overall look and feel of postpartum skin.
